_readme: Listings the Outscraper import lets through that are not bike rental businesses. Google lists 'Bicycle rental service' among a business's categories when it is not what the business does, so the importer cannot catch these on its own. Each entry is dropped from every page, index and sitemap. Keep a reason on each so the list stays auditable. A reason starting with 'Closed' marks a business that has shut down; a reason starting with 'Removed' marks one taken down at the owner's request. In both cases its old shop URLs (/cities/<town>/<shop>/, /partners/<shop>/, /reviews/<shop>/) 301 to its town page, or to /cities/ when the town has no page.

listings.reason: Restaurant, caterer and wedding venue in Daytona Beach. 'Bicycle rental service' is one of ten Google categories; one review, rated 1.0.

Duplicate Google profile for Electribike's 10801 Collins Ave (Haulover/Bal Harbour) location, same address and phone as haulover-bike-rentals. Merged into haulover-bike-rentals, which 301-redirects from this slug.

Closed. Coast Bike Share (powered by HOPR), a Tampa bike-share system, closed all of its Tampa sites and no longer operates in Florida (gohopr.com/coast/, checked 2026-10-31). Its old URLs 301 to the Tampa town page.

Closed. Ocean E-Bikes, a Punta Gorda e-bike rental, went out of business at least two years ago, as reported on 2026-10-31 by the owner of Jersey Joe's Bike and Ebike Rental, a neighboring Punta Gorda rental shop. Its Google profile has no website and no reviews. Its old URLs 301 to the Punta Gorda town page.
Removed at owner's request 2026-11-05 (venomtransporters@gmail.com): confirmed they do not rent. Bradenton sales/mobility shop; old URLs 301 to the Bradenton town page.
